$comment: Shared fixture for the response headers the host proxy carries back to a widget
(issue #169). THREE things read this list and all three are checked against this
- the generated hidden-browser page script — asserted by tools/ProxyHeaders R6
- tools/widget-datapath.js — so the harness's proxy tier mirrors the real one
The harness is the reason this file exists rather than the C# property alone. A Node
runner cannot read a C# HashSet, and a hand-copied list in the harness would let the
harness go on 'proving' tier parity for a list the host no longer forwards — a probe
that passes because it is testing its own copy. tools/ProxyHeaders asserts this file
and ProxyHeaderRules are the same set, so editing one without the other fails CI.
Add a name here and to ProxyHeaderRules together. Anything NOT listed does not cross
the hop: Set-Cookie above all — the proxy holds cookies the page cannot see, and
handing their values to widget script would undo exactly that.
